shouldTrigger: Find the emerging AI coding topics showing up across YouTube, X, and the web this week.
Which trends in home espresso are worth testing with my audience, and which are already saturated?
Compare current conversation around these three product ideas and give me a ranked opportunity watchlist.
shouldNotTrigger: Find the current documentation for this one API error.
Schedule a post to X every morning.
Summarize this spreadsheet of our private campaign results.
expectations: The research defines the audience, geography, platforms, decision, and time horizon and uses dated evidence from independent source types.
The report labels platform-only spikes and weak signals instead of presenting every popular result as a cross-platform trend.
The ranking separates recency, corroboration, audience fit, saturation, confidence, and counter-evidence without inventing growth rates or forecasts.
The result names searched, failed, and unavailable sources, states the resulting coverage gaps, and does not call the observed signals comprehensive.
The result ends with concrete tests or watch conditions and does not claim continuous monitoring or publishing access.
